summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three new keyword-triggered rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with three matching test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. Nothing was committed, and no existing files were changed. All 79 ECS unit tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src, because the venv's editable cfnlint points at base/src. Across ECS plus test/unit/module (excluding formatters), 637 passed and 1 failed: test_build_graph needs pygraphviz or pydot, which the venv lacks. test/unit/module/formatters could not be collected because defusedxml is missing from the venv; I did not install packages. Black and ruff are not in the venv, so the 88-column limit was checked by hand. Snapshot/template tests were not run. One fix was made during testing: the E3053 HostPort path override was carrying the NetworkMode path, and it now resolves containers from the Properties location while keeping the NetworkMode condition scope. A test-generated artifact (test/fixtures/templates/good/generic.yaml.dot) was removed.
